description: Code underlying the publication: Can an energy only market enable resource adequacy in a decarbonized power system? A co-simulation with two agent-based-models is a model or code deposit deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Ingrid Sanchez Jimenez. This co-simulation is based on the Spinetoolbox, its purpose is to combine the strengths of 2 agent-based models (ABM), EMLabpy and AMIRIS to analyze market designs, such as capacity remuneration mechanisms.EMLabpy is an ABM that simulates myopic energy generation investment decisions. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: Python. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
